description: This file defines the ModifyAclResponse class, which represents the response to a ModifyAcl command in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances corresponding to different HTTP status codes, parsing JSON input into objects, and exposing the modified AccessControlList and associated ThingId.

classes.name: ModifyAclResponse
classes.description: Response object for the ModifyAcl command, representing success, creation, or modification of an AccessControlList for a Thing, including JSON serialization/deserialization and HTTP status handling.

methods.name: created
methods.description: Creates a response indicating a new ACL has been created with HTTP status 201.

methods.name: modified
methods.description: Creates a response indicating an ACL has been modified with HTTP status 204.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or object to create a ModifyAclResponse instance.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ThingId associated with this response.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the ACL as a JSON Value according to the schema version if the response indicates creation.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the response with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns supported JSON schema versions for this response.
